data.title: 樱岛麻衣 · 清晨被窝的慵懒晨曦
data.description: 清晨明亮的阳光洒在宽敞柔软的大床上，微尘在光束中静静起舞。麻衣学姐刚刚从香甜的睡眠中苏醒，身穿一件宽松的白衬衫，领口随意散开，露出精致优雅的锁骨与肩颈线条。她坐在松软的枕头堆间，双腿屈起，一只白皙小手揉着微红惺忪的紫眸，凌乱的发丝垂在脸颊两侧，带着刚醒时的无防备软糯，看向床边的你。
data.action: 坐在阳光枕堆间屈膝抱膝，单手轻揉惺忪睡眼，衣襟微敞，神态娇憨甜美看向观众
data.lighting: 清晨明媚自然的窗前晨曦
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, eye level medium shot
data.mood: 日常生活里最真实动人的爱意与温馨
data.promptProse: Mai lounges across the rumpled white bed facing the viewer in an oversized unbuttoned white shirt slipping off her shoulder, displaying her delicate collarbone, cleavage, and long bare legs; golden morning sunlight streams across her affectionate, teasing smile.
data.animaCaption: Reclining on the bed facing the viewer, her unbuttoned oversized white shirt highlights her delicate collarbone, cleavage, and bare legs in morning sun.
